description: This source file defines an Android activity class 'MainActivity' that serves as the launcher for an application demonstrating interpolators. It initializes UI components, manages menu interactions, and sets up logging mechanisms.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity class extending SampleActivityBase, managing a UI that includes a toggleable log view, and initializing logging for debugging and diagnostics.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and loads an InterpolatorFragment into the content area.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from XML.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the options menu, showing or hiding the log toggle based on view type.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, toggling log display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging chain with layered log nodes, including a log wrapper, message filter, and log fragment view.
